title: Agent worker bundle-diff result
description: Canonical camelCase wire format. Studio deserializes Web-default case-insensitive names. All properties below are required and non-null. String limits are additionally checked as UTF-16 units by check-result.mjs (JSON Schema maxLength counts code points). Usage raw JSON is at most 8192 characters; metadata serialized with diff set to an empty string is at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes. Studio also checks the decoded diff against its configured MaxDiffBytes and validates its SHA-256 and patch. Correlation GUID values must equal the launch request. The strict schema requires Studio correlation; the harness checker validates GUID keys only when DIRECT_CORRELATION supplied all four valid GUIDs, retaining opaque-object compatibility for other callers. Such opaque results are not Studio-ready.

diff.description: Exact UTF-8 git diff against the baseline, including trailing newlines.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact decoded diff bytes; checked by the receiver after transport validation.

usage.description: Original raw JSON text must be at most 8192 UTF-16 characters, including internal whitespace and escapes.
